cover letter
High School Diploma required.
Bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated ability to provide quality customer service, written, over the phone, or in person.
Minimum 3 years of Case Management.
Minimum 1 year Pension Administration Customer Support experience

30% Customer Service: Provides timely and accurate information and guidance to those who contact RASC through phone and written correspondence channels regarding UC Retirement Plan benefits, including survivor and health and welfare benefits. Always considers the customer’s point-of-view and anticipates customers’ needs when dealing with complex written and verbal inquiries from both.

15% Benefit Processing & Case Management: Processes benefit applications to ensure timely payment of benefits. Monitors progress of case completion. Responds to escalated, complex, and sensitive client-related account issues in adherence to UCRP Plan design, rules, regulation, policy, and procedures. Researches and resolves complex member-related system issues and may test, recommend, and implement system enhancement or continuous improvement projects.

10% Quality Assurance & Compliance: Conducts quality assurance evaluations, monitoring case management and inbound and outbound calls to ensure a high level of service delivery. Participates in and may conduct quality assurance evaluations and surveys to gauge customer satisfaction and quality service delivery. Adheres to, effectively applies, and remains current on informational updates, UC and RASC policy and procedures, departmental practices in coordination and compliance within the UCRP Plan Design to ensure consistent application.

20% Team Support & Leadership: Acts as a resource for staff, leadership, clients, as well as internal and external business partners. Supports the Survivor Intake team, supervisor, and RASC leadership by providing timely and accurate information. Supports supervisor and manager in analyzing and evaluating data. Supports the supervisor and manager in providing training and coaching to staff. May monitor the workflow of the team to ensure that quality metrics are reported, and operational efficiencies are streamlined, improved, and met as needed.

15% Operational Excellence: Collaborates with the supervisor and manager to build a culture of delivering exemplary service to internal and external clients and to support strategies focused on operational excellence and process and/or workflow improvements. Works closely with the supervisor and manager to ensure that department goals and performance targets are met while maintaining compliance with the plan policy and budget. Recommends improvements to system processing and changes to the plan and regulations. Stays up to date on industry trends, best practices, and technology. Supports the Manager in evaluating and analyzing data and trends to improve the service experience and ensure quality results.

10% Training and Development: Confers with the supervisor to identify, recommend, and may provide the appropriate training to further staff development and on-the-job performance. Supports the supervisor and manager in facilitating staff cross-learning across lines of business. Supports the supervisor and manager in facilitating team development functions, which may include attending pre-hire group interview sessions, onboarding, and mentoring inexperienced staff.
Able to deliver consistent quality service to both internal and external business partners.
Retirement Service Center Customer Service Representative 3
Able to troubleshoot and resolve complex, and emerging issues through critical thinking, problem analysis, and decision-making.
Able to work collaboratively as a team member or individually with others in a respectful and professional manner.
Ability to meet production goals and provide quality service.
Strong organization, prioritization, and time-management skills.
Exemplary written communication skills.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Suite and PC applications.
Able to build and maintain business and technical knowledge for accurate dissemination of information.
